rawContent: The replies on that Coach Norvell tweet are exactly what you should expect any tweet with the hashtag #BLM on it to have. A mixture of supporters, obvious bots, and the FSU fans that 100% chance were on the wrong side of the civil rights act of 1964

Imagine if the Jacob Blake was white and the cop who shot him 7 times in the back was black. Do you know what people who support #BLM would do? WE'D STILL DEMAND POLICE REFORM. The entire point of all this shit is that police have been left unchecked while abusing their power
